compatibility: New preset; requires vllm #889. VRAM prefix cache only (CACHE_MODE=lmcache is not available at TP3).
details: TP3 with expert parallelism, MTP3 and eight request slots; FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE with autotune, flashkda prefill, a 256 KiB one-shot all-reduce cutoff, half L2 prefetch budgets and a finer CUDA-graph ladder.
Large dense projections decode in FP8 (VLLM_GLM53_FP8_DENSE=0 keeps them BF16).
